explanation: Generated a 1-point eta-channel EXCLURAD input at W=1.4885 GeV, Q2=0.5 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.2, phi*=60 deg using the eta defaults from this repository (model=3, full RC, beam momentum 6.53 GeV, ivec=1, vcut=0.166). This point is physically allowed because the p eta threshold is approximately m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.48613 GeV, so the requested W is about 2.37 MeV above threshold. It is, however, very close to threshold, and this codebase explicitly warns that near-threshold eta runs can hit unphysical/stability issues; if you execute many such points, prefer the repository's unphysical-skip runner. The environment here is read-only for the source trees and has no compiler/shell, so I could only generate the input file, not run EXCLURAD.
